The checksum is explicitly provided, ensuring integrity verification later in the build process. There are no signs of obfuscated code, unexpected network operations, or data exfiltration attempts during sourcing. All operations in the global scope are static and safe for `--printsrcinfo`.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no security risk.
</details>
